```{r setup}
rm(list = ls())

library(data.table)
library(fixest)
library(here)
library(knitr)

track        <- "cross-section-may2026"
tables_path  <- here("tracks", track, "latex", "tables")
dir.create(tables_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Source: tracks/cross-section-may2026/data/cohort_2014_YYYYMMDD.rds
# Built by: tracks/cross-section-may2026/code/sample-construction/01_build_bank_dataset_20260511.R
# Contents: 80 banks (>=100 brick-and-mortar branches in 2014), open_share +
#   Call Report 2014-Q4 vars + SOD-derived geography.
data_dir <- here("tracks", track, "data")
rds_file <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "^cohort_2014_\\d{8}\\.rds$",
                       full.names = TRUE) |> sort() |> tail(1)
cat("Loading: ", rds_file, "\n", sep = "")
dt <- as.data.table(readRDS(rds_file))

dt <- dt[!is.na(open_share)]
cat("N with valid open_share: ", nrow(dt), "\n", sep = "")
```

```{r var-list}
vars <- c(
  log_assets         = "log(Assets)",
  log_deposits       = "log(Deposits)",
  log_branches       = "log(Branches 2014)",
  equity_assets      = "Equity / Assets",
  roa                = "ROA",
  nim                = "NIM",
  eff_ratio          = "Efficiency Ratio",
  nonint_exp_assets  = "Noninterest Exp / Assets",
  premises_assets    = "Premises / Assets",
  loans_assets       = "Loans / Assets",
  securities_assets  = "Securities / Assets",
  cash_assets        = "Cash / Assets",
  re_share           = "RE Loans / Loans",
  ci_share           = "C\\&I Loans / Loans",
  cons_share         = "Consumer Loans / Loans",
  cc_share           = "Credit Card Loans / Loans",
  llres_loans        = "Allowance / Loans",
  net_chargeoffs_loans = "Net Charge-offs / Loans",
  deposits_assets    = "Deposits / Assets",
  nib_share          = "Noninterest-Bearing Dep Share",
  brokered_share     = "Brokered Dep / Deposits",
  log_dep_per_branch = "log(Deposits / Branch)",
  branch_geo_hhi     = "Own-Deposit Geographic HHI",
  avg_local_hhi      = "Avg County Deposit HHI",
  n_counties         = "Counties Operated",
  n_states           = "States Operated",
  log_employees      = "log(Employees)",
  assets_per_employee = "Assets / Employee"
)

# Standardize each RHS variable (z-score) so coefficients are
# "change in open_share per 1 SD increase in X".
for (v in names(vars)) {
  z_col <- paste0(v, "_z")
  x <- dt[[v]]
  dt[, (z_col) := (x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)]
}
```

```{r univariate-scan}
fit_one <- function(v) {
  z <- paste0(v, "_z")
  m <- feols(as.formula(paste("open_share ~", z)), data = dt)
  s <- summary(m)
  cf <- s$coeftable
  data.table(
    var  = v,
    beta = cf[2, 1],
    se   = cf[2, 2],
    t    = cf[2, 3],
    p    = cf[2, 4],
    r2   = fitstat(m, "r2", verbose = FALSE)$r2,
    n    = nobs(m)
  )
}

uni <- rbindlist(lapply(names(vars), fit_one))
uni[, label := vars[var]]
setorder(uni, p)
uni
```

```{r univariate-table}
stars <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "",
                     ifelse(p < 0.01, "***",
                     ifelse(p < 0.05, "**",
                     ifelse(p < 0.10, "*", ""))))
fmt <- function(x, d) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d)

out_uni <- uni[, .(
  Variable = label,
  beta = paste0(fmt(beta, 4), stars(p)),
  SE   = fmt(se, 4),
  t    = fmt(t, 2),
  p    = fmt(p, 3),
  R2   = fmt(r2, 3)
)]
setnames(out_uni, "beta", "$\\beta$ (1 SD)")

md <- kable(out_uni, format = "pipe", row.names = FALSE, align = "lrrrrr")
writeLines(as.character(md),
           file.path(tables_path, "tab_open_share_univariate.md"))

tex <- kable(out_uni, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE,
             align = "lrrrrr", escape = FALSE, linesep = "")
writeLines(as.character(tex),
           file.path(tables_path, "tab_open_share_univariate.tex"))

cat("Wrote:\n  ",
    file.path(tables_path, "tab_open_share_univariate.md"), "\n  ",
    file.path(tables_path, "tab_open_share_univariate.tex"), "\n")
```

```{r multivariate}
# Parsimonious set: drop near-duplicates (log_assets vs log_deposits vs log_branches),
# keep one size proxy. Drop sample-redundant geography (n_states ~ n_counties).
# All RHS standardized.
m_full <- feols(open_share ~ log_assets_z + equity_assets_z + roa_z +
                  premises_assets_z + loans_assets_z + securities_assets_z +
                  re_share_z + ci_share_z + cc_share_z +
                  nib_share_z + brokered_share_z +
                  net_chargeoffs_loans_z +
                  avg_local_hhi_z + log_dep_per_branch_z,
                data = dt)

m_small <- feols(open_share ~ log_assets_z + roa_z + premises_assets_z +
                   re_share_z + cc_share_z + nib_share_z +
                   avg_local_hhi_z + log_dep_per_branch_z,
                 data = dt)

et <- etable(m_small, m_full,
             headers = c("Parsimonious", "Full"),
             dict = c(
               log_assets_z         = "log(Assets)",
               equity_assets_z      = "Equity/Assets",
               roa_z                = "ROA",
               premises_assets_z    = "Premises/Assets",
               loans_assets_z       = "Loans/Assets",
               securities_assets_z  = "Securities/Assets",
               re_share_z           = "RE Share",
               ci_share_z           = "C\\&I Share",
               cc_share_z           = "Credit Card Share",
               nib_share_z          = "NIB Dep Share",
               brokered_share_z     = "Brokered Dep Share",
               net_chargeoffs_loans_z = "Net Charge-offs/Loans",
               avg_local_hhi_z      = "Avg County HHI",
               log_dep_per_branch_z = "log(Dep/Branch)"
             ),
             digits = 3,
             tex    = FALSE)

# Markdown version
df <- as.data.frame(et, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rownames(df) <- NULL
md2 <- kable(df, format = "pipe", row.names = FALSE)
writeLines(as.character(md2),
           file.path(tables_path, "tab_open_share_multivariate.md"))

# TeX (tabular only)
tex_out <- etable(m_small, m_full,
                  headers = c("Parsimonious", "Full"),
                  dict = c(
                    log_assets_z         = "log(Assets)",
                    equity_assets_z      = "Equity/Assets",
                    roa_z                = "ROA",
                    premises_assets_z    = "Premises/Assets",
                    loans_assets_z       = "Loans/Assets",
                    securities_assets_z  = "Securities/Assets",
                    re_share_z           = "RE Share",
                    ci_share_z           = "C\\&I Share",
                    cc_share_z           = "Credit Card Share",
                    nib_share_z          = "NIB Dep Share",
                    brokered_share_z     = "Brokered Dep Share",
                    net_chargeoffs_loans_z = "Net Charge-offs/Loans",
                    avg_local_hhi_z      = "Avg County HHI",
                    log_dep_per_branch_z = "log(Dep/Branch)"
                  ),
                  digits = 3,
                  tex = TRUE,
                  style.tex = style.tex("base"))
writeLines(as.character(tex_out),
           file.path(tables_path, "tab_open_share_multivariate.tex"))

cat("Wrote:\n  ",
    file.path(tables_path, "tab_open_share_multivariate.md"), "\n  ",
    file.path(tables_path, "tab_open_share_multivariate.tex"), "\n")
```

```{r key-summary}
# Univariate key-coefficient summary
sig_rows <- uni[p < 0.10][order(p)]
cat("Univariate hits (p < 0.10):\n")
print(sig_rows[, .(label, beta = round(beta, 4), t = round(t, 2),
                   p = round(p, 3), R2 = round(r2, 3))])

cat("\nMultivariate parsimonious R^2 = ",
    round(fitstat(m_small, "r2", verbose = FALSE)$r2, 3), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Multivariate full R^2         = ",
    round(fitstat(m_full,  "r2", verbose = FALSE)$r2, 3), "\n", sep = "")
```
